title: Isandro and the Yearbook
author: Freya Nystrom
blurb: Emrys Underhill, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before the last game of the season.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
